analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard for monitoring store operations efficiency over time, combining key KPIs and trends such as store revenue, revenue per square foot, energy cost and kWh usage, staffing levels and hours, visitor counts, maintenance downtime and costs, and shrinkage impact. By default it focuses on the last 12 months and can be segmented using acquisition channel and loyalty tier filters.
analyticalDashboards.title: Store Operations Efficiency

widget.title: Staff Count and Staff Count by Quarter

analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard for monitoring staff productivity and scheduling by linking labor (staff hours and staff counts) to operational outcomes such as revenue per staff hour, energy cost, and shrinkage trends. It brings together time-series views by month/quarter/year and comparisons across channels (In-Store vs Online) and regions to help spot staffing and cost changes over time. By default it is scoped to the last 12 months and can be further narrowed by store region and loyalty tier selections.
analyticalDashboards.title: Staff Productivity & Scheduling

analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard for monitoring store traffic and related operational KPIs over time, bringing together visitor counts along with shrinkage, maintenance cost, and downtime trends by month/quarter/year across in-store and online channels (with some views focused on the North region). By default it is filtered to the last 12 months, with optional filter controls for exchange rate to USD and fiscal period.
analyticalDashboards.title: Footfall & Store Traffic

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: GlobalMart has two date dimensions, and choosing the wrong one silently changes the answer.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `transaction_date` for operational questions: daily sales, footfall, stock movement. It is when the transaction happened.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `fiscal_date` for anything compared against a budget or reported by period, because the fiscal year does not start in January.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: When a question says "last quarter" in a financial context it means a fiscal quarter, so group by `fiscal_date`.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Three metrics have "revenue" in the name and they are not interchangeable.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `metric_l1_total_net_revenue` by default. Net revenue is after returns and discounts.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: `metric_l1_sql_margin_bridge_gross_revenue` is gross, before returns and discounts. It exists for the margin bridge and is the wrong figure elsewhere.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: `metric_l1_sql_net_sales_summary_net_revenue` agrees with total net revenue but is scoped to its own SQL dataset's grain, so it does not slice by every dimension.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: GlobalMart's metrics are layered, and the layer is in both the metric id and its tags, L1 through L5.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L1 metrics (`metric_l1_*`) are base aggregations over a single fact column. They are the only layer that touches a fact directly.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L2 metrics (`metric_l2_cross_*`) are ratios between two L1 metrics, such as order count over net revenue.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L3 metrics (`metric_l3_*`) apply a filter to an L1 or L2 metric, usually a WHERE on a dimension attribute such as channel type.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L4 and L5 metrics compose further on top of the lower layers.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Prefer the lowest layer that answers the question. Total net revenue is an L1 metric; net revenue for one channel is an existing L3 metric, not an L1 metric with a filter added.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

metrics.description: Returns the maximum value of total kWh consumed within the selected data and filters.
metrics.title: Maximum Total kWh Consumed

metrics.description: Shows the total cost of energy consumption within the current analysis scope (such as applied filters and the selected time period). Use it to track overall spending and compare energy-consumption costs across different groups or periods.
metrics.title: Total Cost (Energy Consumption)

metrics.description: Sums energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) to show the total amount of electricity used. Use this metric to track overall energy usage and compare consumption across different slices of the Energy Consumption data.
metrics.title: Total kWh (Energy Consumption)

metrics.description: Sums the total downtime hours logged on maintenance requests. Use this metric to track overall equipment or service disruption time based on Maintenance Request data.
metrics.title: Total Downtime Hours (Maintenance Request)

metrics.description: Shows the total maintenance spend by summing Maintenance Cost across Maintenance Request records, respecting the current date range and any applied filters.
metrics.title: Total Maintenance Cost (Maintenance Request)

metrics.description: Shows the total monetary value of shrinkage by summing the Shrinkage Amount recorded in the Shrinkage Event dataset for the current analysis scope (such as selected time period, location, or other filters). Used to track overall shrinkage impact across events.
metrics.title: Total Shrinkage Amount (Shrinkage Event)

metrics.description: Sums the Unit Count across all records in the Shrinkage Event dataset to show the total number of units involved in shrinkage events. Use it to quantify shrinkage volume and compare it by product, location, or time when paired with relevant attributes.
metrics.title: Total Unit Count (Shrinkage Event)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of staff recorded in the Daily Store Staffing data by summing Staff Count for the selected time period and any applied filters (such as store or date). Use it to track and compare overall staffing levels across time or locations.
metrics.title: Total Staff Count (Daily Store Staffing)

metrics.description: Tracks the total number of staff hours recorded in the Daily Store Staffing data, summed over the selected time period and any applied filters. Use it to monitor overall labor hours and support store staffing and workforce analysis.
metrics.title: Total Staff Hours (Daily Store Staffing)

metrics.description: Sums square footage from the Store Visit Census data to show total space across the selected records. Use it to quantify overall Sq Ft in reports and dashboards, and break it down by other dimensions as needed.
metrics.title: Total Sq Ft (Store Visit Census)

metrics.description: Total number of visitors captured in the Store Visit Census data, calculated by summing Visitor Count. Use it to track overall foot traffic and compare visitor volumes across time, locations, or other breakdowns.
metrics.title: Total Visitor Count (Store Visit Census)

metrics.description: Shows the total revenue generated per square foot by summing the “Revenue per Sq Ft” values from the Operations Efficiency Summary data for the current selection (such as time period, location, or other filters). Use it to compare overall space productivity across segments.
metrics.title: Total Revenue per Sq Ft (Operations Efficiency Summary)

metrics.description: Shows the total Revenue per Staff Hour by summing this value across the selected slice of the Operations Efficiency Summary data. Use it to assess overall labor productivity and operational efficiency in the current view.
metrics.title: Total Revenue per Staff Hour (Operations Efficiency Summary)

metrics.description: Shows the total revenue generated by stores by summing Store Revenue from the Operations Efficiency Summary data for the selected filters and reporting period.
metrics.title: Total Store Revenue (Operations Efficiency Summary)

metrics.description: Compares changes in labor hours to changes in headcount by calculating the difference between total staff hours and total staff count from the Daily Store Staffing data for the selected period and any applied filters. Use it to see whether overall staffing effort is rising or falling relative to the number of staff.
metrics.title: Staff Hours (Daily Store Staffing) vs Staff Count (Daily Store Staffing) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between total staff count (from Daily Store Staffing) and total shrinkage amount (from Shrinkage Event) within the selected time period and filters. Use it to monitor how changes in staffing levels compare to shrinkage impact in the same reporting scope.
metrics.title: Staff Count (Daily Store Staffing) vs Shrinkage Amount (Shrinkage Event) Change

metrics.description: Compares the overall change in shrinkage by subtracting total unit count from total shrinkage amount within the selected reporting scope. Use it to see how shrinkage value is shifting relative to the volume of units involved in shrinkage events.
metrics.title: Shrinkage Amount (Shrinkage Event) vs Unit Count (Shrinkage Event) Change

metrics.description: Net change between shrinkage volume and maintenance spend, calculated as Total Unit Count from Shrinkage Events minus Total Maintenance Cost from Maintenance Requests. Use it to assess whether shrinkage activity outweighs maintenance costs for the selected filters and time period.
metrics.title: Unit Count (Shrinkage Event) vs Maintenance Cost (Maintenance Request) Change

metrics.description: Total energy consumption cost limited to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare in-store energy spending across time periods or other breakdowns while excluding other channel types.

metrics.description: Tracks total energy consumption cost for the Online sales channel only, so you can monitor and compare energy-related spending tied to online activity across the selected time period and any applied filters.

metrics.description: Total energy consumption cost restricted to the North region. Use it to monitor and compare energy-related spending for North within the current reporting scope (including any applied filters and time period).

metrics.description: Total staff hours for the In-Store sales channel, summed over the selected time period and any other applied filters. Use this metric to track labor hours specifically for in-store operations and staffing needs.

metrics.description: Total staff hours from the Daily Store Staffing data, filtered to stores in the North region. Use this metric to monitor overall labor hours for North-region staffing across the selected reporting period and any other applied filters.

metrics.description: Total number of staff recorded in the Daily Store Staffing data, limited to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor in-store staffing levels over the selected dates and any other applied filters (such as store).

metrics.description: Total monetary value of shrinkage recorded in the Shrinkage Event data, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and report in-store shrinkage value across the current analysis scope (for example, selected time period or location).

attributes.title: Channel ID (Sales Channel)

attributes.description: Sales channel name used to categorize and filter results by where sales occurred (e.g., online, retail, partner) within the Sales Channel dataset.
attributes.title: Channel Name (Sales Channel)

sql.statement:
SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(ol.revenue) AS store_revenue,
    SUM(fsd.sqft) AS store_sqft,
    SUM(COALESCE(sh.staff_hours, 0)) AS total_staff_hours,
    SUM(ol.revenue) / SUM(fsd.sqft) AS revenue_per_sqft,
    SUM(ol.revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(sh.staff_hours, 0)), 0) AS revenue_per_staff_hour
FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.dim_store s
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_header oh ON s.store_id = oh.store_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_line ol ON oh.order_id = ol.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(sqft) AS sqft
    FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_store_visit_census GROUP BY store_id
) fsd ON s.store_id = fsd.store_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_store_staffing_daily sh ON s.store_id = sh.store_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
